w# Proposal: Modernising Team Feedback & Recognition

### Connecting Telegram Community Discussions with Control Hub Workflows

**Prepared For:** May, Chief Operating Officer & Cams, HR Manager

**Prepared By:** Cef, AI Specialist  
**Initiative:** Community-Driven Feedback & Portal Engagement System

---

## 1\. Executive Summary

As our organization grows, gathering timely feedback and keeping team members engaged with our internal tools is vital.

Currently, team members and leadership naturally gravitate toward **Telegram** for quick, spontaneous discussions. However, our formal tracking happens inside **Control Hub**. When feedback is shared only in chat rooms, important suggestions get lost, duplicate questions arise, and staff cannot easily see if their concerns are being addressed.

This proposal introduces a **unified bridge** between Telegram and Control Hub:

1. **Frictionless Feedback for Leadership & Staff:** Anyone can share ideas or report issues directly in Telegram without navigating complex web forms.  
2. **Accountability & Organization:** Discussions seamlessly turn into tracked tasks in Control Hub, with status updates posted back to Telegram automatically.  
3. **HR Engagement & Recognition:** Active portal usage tracked by HR is converted into celebratory weekly shoutouts and rewards, creating positive reinforcement without added manual work.

---

## 2\. The Core Problem & Our Opportunity

| Current Challenge in Chat | How the Bridge Solves It | Benefit to Leadership & HR |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Lost Ideas:** Valuable suggestions get buried under dozens of chat messages. | One-touch conversion saves the message straight into our team queue. | No good ideas or complaints fall through the cracks. |
| **"What's the status?" Questions:** Staff repeatedly ask if issues are being worked on. | The system sends automated progress notes when a ticket moves forward. | Complete transparency without manual follow-up messages. |
| **Low Portal Adoption:** Team members sometimes forget to log into Control Hub regularly. | A weekly gamified leaderboard celebrates our most engaged staff. | Encourages daily adoption through positive reinforcement. |

---

## 5\. Employee Trust, Privacy & Etiquette

A successful engagement system must inspire motivation, not anxiety. We propose the following ground rules:

* **Celebratory, Not Punitive:** The public leaderboard only showcases positive milestones and top contributors. It will never publish negative performance metrics or inactive users.  
* **Respecting Deep Work:** Automated notifications are batched and posted in dedicated topics with quiet hours enforced after business hours.  
* **Clear Ownership:** The tech team owns the ticket resolution speed, while HR owns the recognition criteria and reward definitions.
